senses.gloss: mosaic pavement, esp. the paved level space between steps in the Temple hall, landing, terrace.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 4:3">Yoma IV, 3</cite> <he>הר׳ הרביעי שבהיכל</he>, emended <cite ref="Yoma 43b:17">ib. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>של היכל</he>, the fourth terrace on coming from the hall.

<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 3:6">Midd. III, 6</cite> <he>רום מעלה … ור׳ שלשה וכ׳</he> the height of each step was half a cubit, its depth one cubit each of the three steps, and a landing of three cubits &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 4:23">Tosef. Succ. IV, 23</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 11:13">Tosef. Men. XI, 13</cite> <he>הר׳ שבאולם</he> the pavement in the hall.—Pl. <he>רוֹבְדִים</he>, <he>רוֹבְדִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:1">Tam. I, 1</cite> <he>היה מוקף ר׳ של אבן</he> was surrounded with stone pavements; <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:8">Midd. I, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 17:1">Tosef. Ohol. XVII, 1</cite> <he>משוקעין בר׳ ובאבנים</he> sunk in and covered with paving blocks or with (rough) stones.

senses.gloss: the interlaced branches of two neighboring trees.—Pl. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 140b:16">Ḥull. 140ᵇ</cite> <he>היתה יושבת בין שני רוֹבְדֵי אילן</he> if the mother bird is found sitting on the junction of two trees.
